extraction.Name: Orlando Clifford
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want the patent in fee to his 640 acre allotment, as he did not want to pay taxes—in fact, he protested strongly against it; but was informed that it would be taxed just the same as if he did take it, and later sold for taxes, so he accepted the patent
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged the whole section to the State of South Dakota, for $4000.00, in order to make improvements on the place; that he made two payments on this mortgage, then he began having sickness, and, in 1926, they took the land from him; that he considers it just about a total loss
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: he paid his 1919 taxes on this section of land; began having sickness and in 1926 they took the land from him
extraction.Occupation/Income: he runs a dairy for a living, which constitutes his only income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has fair health except for rheumatism; has a wife who has good health; mortgaged in March 1920; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; allotment was 640 acres (whole section); document subscribed and sworn December 5, 1928, Shannon County, South Dakota | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge (Shannon County, South Dakota)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
